summary.name: Rosebud AI
summary.one_liner: Rosebud AI is a browser-based AI game maker where you describe a game in a prompt or start from a template, then build and deploy it without coding.
use_cases: Building a simple game from a text description
Starting a game from a ready-made template
Making interactive stories or visual novels
Creating 3D web apps through vibe coding
Generating sprites, 3D models and skyboxes for games
summary.what_it_does: The page offers a game creation flow where users describe a game in a prompt or pick a template such as Interactive Story, RPG, Vampire Survivors, City Builder, Multiplayer Obby, Voxel World, or Crowd Rush. Some templates (3D Quest, FPS) are marked Coming Soon. The site lists product areas including a game creator, AI storybook, AI 3D website builder, and free game hosting. It also lists AI asset generators for 2D art, sprite sheets, 3D models, and skyboxes, plus features such as AI NPCs and a visual novel maker. The page names underlying models (gpt-sol, claude-opus) in its prompt interface.
notable: No-coding game creation from natural-language prompts or templates
Asset generators for 2D sprites, 3D models and skyboxes
Free game hosting and deployment listed
Includes AI NPCs and visual novel tooling
caveats: Pricing details are not shown on this page; a separate Pricing page is linked
3D Quest and FPS templates are listed as Coming Soon
